spec.design_question: When something real changes on the pill, or you deliberately summon the island with ⌃⌥G, how far may githud step out of perfect stillness — not at all (instant swap + never-key Carbon capture), one visible 150ms breath + a true scoped key session (full crossfade + system focus ring), or a fixed chassis where only the changed cell fades and keys ride an ink-marked scoped session?
spec.current_state: The collapsed pill is rebuilt from scratch on every render and swapped in a single frame — no pill animation exists today: HUDPanelController.render() constructs a brand-new CollapsedPillView (Sources/GithudApp/HUDPanelController.swift:314–318) and present() removes the old content, resizes the panel, and re-centers top-center in the same frame (HUDPanelController.swift:326–338); a poll burst (radar+pulse+freshness) coalesces to exactly ONE rebuild per runloop turn (HUDPanelController.swift:209–216). The pill state vocabulary and its geometry: loading dot 52×36 (Sources/GithudApp/CollapsedPillView.swift:16), count+glyph width = 18+6+digits×10+26 → 60px at 1 digit (CollapsedPillView.swift:33), critical = same layout with the top glyph tinted danger (CollapsedPillView.swift:91, sorts first by contract), caught-up segmented gauge width = 24+Σ(16 glyph+4 gap+digits×9) with 6px inter-segment gaps → 88px for two 1-digit segments (CollapsedPillView.swift:22–28, 98–116), bare check 52 (CollapsedPillView.swift:30), degraded-freshness caution-clock prefix +19px (CollapsedPillView.swift:14, 67–73). Pill height 36 (CollapsedPillView.swift:8), corner radius 14 continuous (CollapsedPillView.swift:44–45), stack spacing 6 (CollapsedPillView.swift:62); counts use monospacedDigitSystemFont 13/semibold (CollapsedPillView.swift:95) so same-digit-count changes already move zero pixels. The ONLY animation in the entire app is the 0.12s easeOut hover fill fade, already Reduce-Motion-aware (Sources/GithudApp/HUDPanel.swift:90–104). Keyboard today: ⌃⌥G is a permissionless Carbon RegisterEventHotKey (Sources/GithudApp/SummonHotkey.swift:30–31, 87–90) wired to show()+setExpanded(true) when hidden, else toggleExpand() (Sources/GithudApp/AppDelegate.swift:78–86); the panel can NEVER become key or main (HUDPanel.swift:11–12), is only ever orderFrontRegardless'd (HUDPanelController.swift:224), so no key event ever reaches the island — rows are mouse-click + VoiceOver accessibilityPerformPress only (Sources/GithudApp/IslandContentView.swift:446–453, 523–526); ↑/↓/Return/Esc do nothing. Click-away collapse is a passive global mouse-down monitor, live only while expanded (HUDPanelController.swift:240–254). Expanded island: width 520 (IslandContentView.swift:9), reactive height with per-lane 240px scroll cap (Sources/GithudCore/IslandGeometry.swift:19; HUDPanelController.swift:302–307), 18px side / 16px top-bottom padding (IslandContentView.swift:109–120), menu-bar gap 8 (IslandGeometry.swift:21). The pill speaks its full state via PillAccessibilityPresenter every render (CollapsedPillView.swift:56; Sources/GithudCore/PillAccessibilityPresenter.swift:27–48). Doctrine anchors: focus-non-theft's pay-out proof literally names 'HUDPanel.canBecomeKey==false' (loop/PRESSURE.md:22–29); attention-non-theft demands motion map 1:1 to an actionable change (loop/PRESSURE.md:87–94).

variants.name: Still Ledger — instant swap + never-key Carbon session
variants.essence: State is a fact, not a movie: the pill never animates (instant single-frame swap, made calm by a shared 3-slot chassis), and the keyboard session never takes key — ↑/↓/↩/⎋ are captured as transient system hotkeys only while summoned.
variants.spec: G-CROSSFADE SIDE (instant, codified): (1) Shared chassis — every pill state renders into one skeleton: [stale prefix slot, 19px, present only when Freshness.isDegraded] [glyph cell 20×18px, glyph 13pt/semibold] [gap 6px] [value cell]. Widths stay the code's exact formulas: loading 52, check 52, count = 18+6+digits×10+26 (60/70/80 for 1/2/3 digits), gauge = 24+Σ(16+4+digits×9)+6·(segments−1) (88 for ✓1·✕1). Height 36, radius 14 continuous, +19 when degraded. (2) Transition policy: ALL changes land in ONE frame — 0ms, no interpolation, no width ease; panel setContentSize + recenter (x = screenMidX − width/2, y = visibleTop − 36 − 8) on the same frame, exactly as present() does today. Same-digit-count changes (3→4) move zero pixels (tabular digits). One swap per poll burst (existing coalescer, HUDPanelController.swift:209). Reduce Motion: nothing to reduce. This variant RATIFIES today's behavior as final; zero new pill code beyond the chassis refactor. G-KEYBOARD SIDE (never-key): On the ⌃⌥G summon-expand path only, register 4 transient Carbon hotkeys with 0 modifiers — kVK_UpArrow(126), kVK_DownArrow(125), kVK_Return(36), kVK_Escape(53), signature 'gthd' ids 2–5 — and unregister ALL of them the instant the island collapses by ANY path (Esc, Return-after-open, second ⌃⌥G, click-away, chevron). canBecomeKey stays false forever. Selection model: selectedIndex over the flattened actionable rows (radar rows in order, then pulse rows; section headers/captions/stale-count lines are skipped). Initial selection = row 0. ↓ = +1 clamped at last, ↑ = −1 clamped at 0, NO wrap. Selected row scrolled to fully visible with 0ms scroll (scrollToVisible, no NSAnimationContext), whole-row. Selection treatment (this is a SELECTION cursor, not focus — nothing has focus): row background rgba(255,255,255,0.06) (= theme.hoverFill) + a 3px × (rowHeight−8px) left bar in inkPrimary #E6EDF3, radius 1.5, inset at x=0; row radius 6. Selection moves in 0ms. Hint footer appears ONLY during the session, right-aligned on the existing footer line: '↑↓ move · ↩ open · esc dismiss', 11px, #484F58. Return = open selected row's URL via the existing openInBrowser path (Open-on-GitHub ceiling), then collapse + unregister. STORYBOARD: F1 editor frontmost, caret blinking, island hidden — user presses ⌃⌥G. F2 island appears expanded (orderFrontRegardless only); editor caret KEEPS BLINKING (focus never moved); selection bar on radar row 1; hint footer on. F3 user types a letter — it lands in the EDITOR (letters were never captured); then presses ↓↓ — bar moves to row 3 in the HUD. This is the honesty frame: split-brain input, shown, not hidden. F4 ↓ past the last radar row — bar crosses into 'Your PRs' row 1 (headers skipped). F5 ↩ — browser opens the PR (browser activates); island collapses; the 4 hotkeys unregister. F6 alt: ⎋ — island collapses, hotkeys unregister, arrows/Esc instantly return to the editor. F7 alt: click anywhere in the editor — click-away collapses + unregisters; the click lands in the editor normally. F8 mouse-only expand (pill click): NO bar, NO hint, NO hotkey capture — proves the boundary. RATIFYING: 'githud never takes key, ever; during a keyboard summon it borrows exactly 4 keys system-wide.' DOCTRINE COST: zero focus-non-theft cost; input-capture cost instead (see risks). REVERT: delete the 4 transient registrations — no panel/pressure change at all.
variants.doctrine_fit: Purist: focus-non-theft's proof line (canBecomeKey==false, PRESSURE.md:22–29) survives verbatim; attention-non-theft gets zero new motion; pulse-honesty absolutist on the pill — an interpolated frame is a state that never existed, and this variant never draws one. Open-on-GitHub ceiling untouched (Return = the same openInBrowser). Gray-swap law trivial: selection is ink + position.
variants.risks: Split-brain input is the honest cost: while the session is live, ↑/↓/↩/⎋ are swallowed SYSTEM-WIDE (a Carbon 0-modifier hotkey is greedy) — the editor keeps focus and letters, but loses arrows without any visible focus change; that is input theft wearing focus-non-theft's letter. If another app owns plain Esc, registration silently fails and the session loses Esc (same degrade contract as SummonHotkey.swift:91–96). No VoiceOver gain — the panel still can't be keyboard-focused by assistive tech. And the instant pill swap stays genuinely subliminal: a 3→4 tick can happen unwitnessed (defensible — the count is correct at next glance — but the user should choose that knowingly).
variants.mock_notes: Pill chassis: div height 36px; border-radius 14px; background #0D1117; border 1px solid #30363D; box-shadow 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45); display flex; align-items center; gap 6px; explicit widths per state: 52 (loading/check), 60 (count 1-digit), 88 (gauge ✓1·✕1), +19 degraded. Count: font 600 13px -apple-system; font-variant-numeric tabular-nums; color #E6EDF3. Loading dot / check: 12px glyph #484F58. Critical shield SVG #F85149. Gauge badges: 16px circles #3FB950 / #F85149 with white 8px SVG ✓/✕, 4px to their tabular count, 6px between segments. Caution clock 12px #D29922. Instant demo: a 'poll tick' button steps a scripted sequence (3→4 → +critical → gauge → +stale prefix → check) with NO CSS transition — swap innerHTML and width in one step. Expanded island for the storyboard: 520px wide, radius 14, padding 16px 18px, header 'Needs you' 600 11px #7D8590 + capsule badge (#2F81F7, h16, radius 8, padding 0 7px, 700 11px white tabular), rows 8px apart: 20px icon cell + 8px gap + title 500 13px #E6EDF3 / subtitle 11px tabular #7D8590 / excerpt 11px #484F58, row radius 6, lane max-height 240px overflow-y auto, footer 'GitHub inbox ↗' 11px #484F58 left + hint right. Storyboard filmstrip: 8 numbered mini-desktops (24px menu-bar strip #1a1a1a, a fake editor window with a caret span 1.5×14px #E6EDF3, animation blink 1s steps(1) infinite — caret KEEPS blinking in every frame of THIS variant), island under an 8px gap. Selected row: background rgba(255,255,255,.06) + ::before 3px bar #E6EDF3 radius 1.5. Make the page capture real ↑↓↩⎋ (preventDefault) to drive selection live; also show typed letters appearing in the fake editor during the session (the F3 honesty beat).

variants.name: Witness Fade — full 150ms crossfade + scoped key session with system ring
variants.essence: A real change deserves one visible breath and a deliberate summon deserves real keys: the whole pill cross-fades over 150ms on any data-driven change, and ⌃⌥G makes the panel genuinely key (Spotlight-style, app never activates) with a system-idiom accent focus ring.
variants.spec: G-CROSSFADE SIDE (the gated 150ms, both-sides demo): TRIGGER — render() computes a pill fingerprint (loading, rows.count, top symbolName, isCritical, gauge segment states+counts, freshness.isDegraded); crossfade fires ONLY when the fingerprint changed on a DATA-driven render; user-initiated renders (expand/collapse, theme switch, first show()) stay instant. ANIMATION — keep the outgoing CollapsedPillView in place; add the incoming one on top at alpha 0, both horizontally centered in the panel; over 150ms with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0): outgoing alpha 1→0, incoming 0→1; simultaneously animate the panel frame (width old→new, origin recomputed so x stays screen-centered, y fixed) via NSAnimationContext duration 0.15 same curve; remove the outgoing view on completion. Digit-only change (3→4, identical width): still a full 150ms content crossfade — the fade IS the information ('this number is newer than your last glance'). One crossfade per poll burst (existing coalescer); if a second change lands mid-fade, jump to end-state instantly then swap. Reduce Motion (NSWorkspace.accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion, same check as HUDPanel.swift:92) → instant swap, always. SHARED-GEOMETRY ANSWER: no chassis needed — the 150ms width ease absorbs the state-to-state geometry differences (52↔60↔88, +19 stale). G-KEYBOARD SIDE (scoped key session, system ring): MECHANISM — HUDPanel gains 'var keySessionActive = false'; override canBecomeKey { keySessionActive }. The ⌃⌥G summon path (AppDelegate.swift:78–86) — and ONLY it — sets keySessionActive = true then calls panel.makeKey() AFTER the expanded render (never makeKeyAndOrderFront, never NSApp.activate — the app stays .accessory and never activates, so the previous app's menu bar stays up and key status snaps back to it on resign; the Spotlight/Raycast pattern). Mouse paths (pill click, status-item click) never set the flag. KEYS — HUDPanel.keyDown: keyCode 125 ↓ / 126 ↑ (selection over the flattened actionable rows: radar then pulse, headers skipped, clamped, no wrap; selected row scrollToVisible whole-row, 0ms), 36 Return (open selected row via existing openInBrowser, then end session + collapse), 53 Esc (end session + collapse). Session also ends on: second ⌃⌥G (existing toggle), click-away (existing monitor), chevron collapse — every end path runs: keySessionActive = false; panel.resignKey(). FOCUS RING — the macOS full-keyboard-access idiom: a 2px ring in accent #2F81F7 drawn 1px outside the selected row's bounds (row radius 6 → ring radius 8), NO background fill; ring jumps row-to-row in 0ms. Initial focus = first actionable row. Hint footer during session only: '↑↓ move · ↩ open · esc dismiss' 11px #484F58, right-aligned on the footer line. A11Y — the key session gives assistive tech a real first-responder for the first time; mirror the selection into accessibilityFocusedUIElement so VoiceOver tracks it. STORYBOARD: F1 editor frontmost, caret blinking — ⌃⌥G. F2 island expands AND takes key: editor caret FREEZES (shown honestly), #2F81F7 ring on radar row 1, hint footer on, menu bar still the editor's. F3 ↓↓ — ring on row 3, lane scrolls whole-row if past the 240px cap. F4 ↓ past last radar row — ring crosses into 'Your PRs'. F5 ↩ — browser opens the thread and activates; island collapses; session over. F6 alt: ⎋ — collapse; key returns to the editor automatically (app never activated); caret resumes blinking. F7 alt: click in the editor — click-away collapses + ends session; the click lands normally. F8 mouse-only expand: no ring, no key, no hint — the scoped boundary, proven. RATIFYING: (a) motion on every real pill change, 150ms, once; (b) 'canBecomeKey==false' relaxes to 'false except during an explicit keyboard summon' — the PRESSURE.md:28 proof line must be re-worded and the focus-non-theft screen-recording proof re-cut to show the MOUSE path never takes key. REVERT: crossfade behind one guard (fingerprint check → instant path); key session behind the single keySessionActive write — set it never-true and ⌃⌥G degrades to today's summon-only. Both are one-line kill switches.
variants.doctrine_fit: On its face both moves are sanctioned: the crossfade maps 1:1 to a real change (INTENT's motion law) and fires at most once per poll burst; the key session is user-consented by definition (the user's own chord is the request) and scoped so the mouse path keeps the letter of focus-non-theft. Return stays inside the Open-on-GitHub ceiling. Ring color is accent (not danger/success) — a focus ring is chrome, not state, so the color doctrine's state budget is untouched; gray-swap holds (position carries the meaning when the ring grays).
variants.risks: The two honest costs the gate names: (1) mid-fade the pill shows a superposition frame (ghost 3 over incoming 4) — a state that never existed, which a pulse-honesty purist can call a fabrication; (2) the width ease means 150ms of peripheral motion on EVERY poll-driven change, even when the user isn't looking — that is precisely the attention-non-theft brush, and it applies to digit ticks that today cost zero pixels. On the keyboard side: taking key genuinely interrupts the editor (caret stops, IME/autocomplete state may drop); any end-path bug that leaves keySessionActive true converts a scoped relaxation into a standing focus-non-theft violation — the revert flag must be provably reset on ALL five end paths.
variants.mock_notes: Same pill/island CSS base as the still-ledger notes (36px pill, radius 14, #0D1117/#30363D/#E6EDF3 etc., island 520px, padding 16/18, lane cap 240). Crossfade demo: a fixed-width stage centering a pill wrapper with 'transition: width 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)'; inside, two absolutely-stacked content layers with 'transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)'; a 'poll tick' button steps the same scripted sequence, side-by-side with an instant column so both gate sides are visible simultaneously; add a 'Reduce Motion' toggle that zeroes both transitions, and a 0.25× slow-mo toggle so the superposition frame is inspectable (that ghost frame is the decision). Key storyboard: 8 mini-desktop frames; editor caret span uses animation blink 1s steps(1) infinite in F1, and 'animation:none; opacity:.35' from F2 (focus honestly gone) until F6/F7 restore it. Focus ring: outline: 2px solid #2F81F7; outline-offset: 1px; border-radius: 6px on the selected row (no fill). Hint footer: flex row, space-between with 'GitHub inbox ↗'; text 11px #484F58. Wire real ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape listeners (preventDefault) to drive the ring + whole-row scrollTop stepping inside the 240px lane.

variants.name: Slot Morph — shared chassis, cell-local fades + scoped key session with ink focus
variants.essence: One chassis so nothing moves that didn't change: digit ticks stay perfectly still, only a genuinely changed cell cross-fades (120ms) with a 150ms width settle on state crossings, and the ⌃⌥G key session marks focus in pure ink (left bar + fill, no hue).
variants.spec: G-CROSSFADE SIDE (the principled middle + the shared-geometry YES): CHASSIS — every pill state renders the same skeleton: [stale prefix slot 19px, only when degraded] [glyph cell 20×18px] [gap 6px] [value cell], height 36, radius 14, widths per the existing formulas (52 / 60+10·extraDigits / 88 gauge / +19 stale). Cell fingerprints: prefix(bool), glyph(symbolName+tint), value(count string | gauge segments | none). TRANSITION RULES — (a) same-state value tick with equal digit count (3→4): INSTANT, 0ms — tabular digits mean zero pixels move; no fade (stillness owns the common case). (b) Cross-state change (count↔gauge↔check↔loading, prefix appears/disappears, digit-count change 9→10): ONLY the changed cell(s) crossfade, 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0) (old cell content alpha 1→0 over the first 80ms, new 0→1 over the last 80ms, 40ms overlap), while unchanged cells never repaint; if total width differs, the pill width eases 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) with the panel re-centered per frame. (c) Critical flip (isCritical becomes true/false): the glyph cell alone cross-fades ink→#F85149 shield (or back) over 120ms — color motion mapped to THE decision-changing event, the doctrine's exact sanctioned case. (d) Reduce Motion → all durations 0. (e) One transition per poll burst (existing coalescer); mid-flight second change jumps to end state. IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE — render() diffs the new pill's cell fingerprints against the previous; on pure (a) it swaps as today; on (b)/(c) it overlays old/new cell layers and runs CABasicAnimation(opacity) + NSAnimationContext frame ease. G-KEYBOARD SIDE (scoped key session, ink focus): identical mechanism to witness-fade — HUDPanel.canBecomeKey { keySessionActive }; flag set ONLY on the ⌃⌥G path; panel.makeKey() after the expanded render; no NSApp.activate; keyDown 125/126/36/53; flattened row selection (radar then pulse, headers skipped, clamped, no wrap); whole-row scrollToVisible 0ms; end on Esc / Return-after-open / second ⌃⌥G / click-away / chevron, every path running keySessionActive=false + resignKey(). FOCUS TREATMENT (ink, no hue): selected row gets background rgba(255,255,255,0.06) (= theme.hoverFill) + a 3px × (rowHeight−8px) left bar in #E6EDF3, radius 1.5, at x=0 inside the row's 6px-radius bounds; moves in 0ms. Hover vs focus grammar: a hovered row shows fill only; the keyboard-selected row shows fill + bar — focus is 'a persistent hover you steer', one vocabulary. Hint footer during session only: '↑↓ move · ↩ open · esc dismiss' 11px #484F58 right-aligned. Initial focus = first actionable row; VoiceOver mirrors selection via accessibilityFocusedUIElement. STORYBOARD: F1 editor frontmost, caret blinking — ⌃⌥G. F2 island expands + takes key; caret freezes (honest); row 1 shows fill+bar; hint footer on. F3 ↓↓ — bar to row 3; lane scrolls whole-row past the 240 cap. F4 ↓ crosses into 'Your PRs' (headers skipped). F5 ↩ — thread opens on GitHub (browser activates), island collapses, session ends. F6 alt ⎋ — collapse, key snaps back, caret resumes. F7 alt click-away — collapse + end, click lands in the other app. F8 mouse-only expand — fill-on-hover only, no bar, no key, no hint (the scoped boundary). RATIFYING: (a) the pill may move ONLY in a changed cell, 120ms, with width settling 150ms — digit ticks stay still forever (a written invariant: 'no motion where no fact changed'); (b) the same canBecomeKey relaxation as witness-fade, PRESSURE.md:28 proof line re-worded, mouse path re-proven never-key. REVERT: cell-fade behind the fingerprint diff (force 'all cells changed→instant' = today); key session behind the single keySessionActive write.
variants.doctrine_fit: Tightest reading of the motion law: motion maps 1:1 not just to a real change but to the CELL that changed — the ghost-frame objection shrinks to a 20px cell, digit ticks (the overwhelmingly common transition) stay at today's zero motion, and the one place color moves is the one place doctrine spends color (critical arrival). The ink focus bar keeps the a11y gray-swap law by construction and adds no new hue to the island. Key session consent + scope identical to witness-fade; Open-on-GitHub ceiling untouched.
variants.risks: Two motion grammars (instant ticks vs faded crossings) is a subtler rule than either extreme — without the written invariant it erodes into 'animate whatever feels nice' over iterations. It is also the most code: cell fingerprint plumbing through render(), overlaid cell layers, and a width ease that must stay centered per-frame (a re-anchor bug here shows as a visible pill drift). The ink bar is less instantly legible as 'keyboard focus' than the system accent ring for users trained on macOS full-keyboard-access. Key-session risks are identical to witness-fade: caret interruption in the editor and the must-prove-all-five-end-paths reset.
variants.mock_notes: Same base CSS numbers (pill 36px/radius 14/#0D1117/#30363D; count 600 13px tabular #E6EDF3; badges 16px #3FB950/#F85149 circles with white 8px glyphs; caution clock #D29922; island 520px, padding 16/18, header #7D8590 11px + #2F81F7 capsule h16 r8, rows 13px/#E6EDF3 + 11px tabular/#7D8590, row radius 6, lane cap 240, footer 11px #484F58). Chassis demo: pill as flex with fixed cells — .prefix{width:19px} .glyph{width:20px;height:18px} .gap{width:6px} .value{...}; 'transition: width 150ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)' on the pill; each cell holds two stacked layers with 'transition: opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)' toggled ONLY when that cell's fingerprint changes (JS diff per tick). Script the same poll sequence and render THREE columns side-by-side — instant / full-150 / slot-morph — off one shared tick button, so the user judges all G-crossfade options in one glance; include Reduce Motion and 0.25× slow-mo toggles. Critical-flip beat: glyph layer swaps ink glyph → #F85149 shield SVG via the same 120ms cell fade. Keyboard storyboard: same 8-frame filmstrip as witness-fade (caret blink → frozen → resumed via animation:none/opacity:.35), but selected row uses background rgba(255,255,255,.06) + ::before{width:3px;background:#E6EDF3;border-radius:1.5px;left:0;top:4px;bottom:4px} instead of an outline; hover on other rows shows fill only (real :hover), proving the fill-vs-bar grammar live. Wire real ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape (preventDefault) for the interactive session.

recommendation.why: It is the only option that answers the shared-geometry question affirmatively (one chassis, so width changes are structurally calm) while spending motion exactly where doctrine grants it — a changed cell, 120ms, once per burst — keeping the common digit tick at today's perfect stillness and shrinking the crossfade's ghost-frame objection to a 20px cell. Its keyboard half takes the proven Spotlight-pattern scoped key session (real a11y gain, one-flag revert) but pays the visual cost in ink, so the gray-swap law and the color budget survive untouched. The two extremes remain in the demo precisely so the user can reject the middle knowingly — but the middle is the one that holds both PRESSURE burdens and change-legibility at once.

verdicts.reason: The G-crossfade half is doctrine-perfect: it ratifies verified current behavior (single-frame swap, HUDPanelController.swift:313-338; one rebuild per burst :209-216; tabular digits already zero-pixel) — zero motion, zero fabrication, nothing to reduce. The G-keyboard half violates focus-non-theft (PRESSURE.md:22-29, 'must never become key or STEAL FOCUS... doesn't interrupt the foreground app') in substance while keeping its pays-out letter: 0-modifier Carbon hotkeys swallow arrows/Return/Esc SYSTEM-WIDE while the frontmost editor's caret keeps blinking — the foreground app loses four keys under a false 'keys land here' signal, a fabricated interaction state under the trust moat (the F3 'honesty frame' is not honest: the only indicator is in the island footer, not at the user's locus of attention). Concrete failure: summon, glance, resume typing (letters pass through so nothing warns; the session persists unbounded — no timeout, click-away needs a mouse), press Return for a newline → githud opens row 0's PR and the browser ACTIVATES: literal focus + attention theft (PRESSURE.md:87-94) fired by an unintended keystroke. Plain-Return/Esc global registration also degrades dialogs/Vim/IME system-wide for the session, and it delivers zero a11y gain (admitted). The variant's own risks section concedes 'input theft wearing focus-non-theft's letter' — a self-refutation the gate should not carry forward as-is.
verdicts.amendment: Delete the 4 transient 0-modifier Carbon registrations entirely (the variant's own REVERT line is the amendment). G-keyboard answer becomes: ⌃⌥G summons/toggles/dismisses; no in-island key navigation, no selection bar, no hint footer; storyboard reduces to F1/F2/F7/F8. Pill side (instant swap + shared chassis refactor) stands unchanged. RATIFYING line becomes 'githud never takes key and never captures a key — keyboard gets summon/dismiss only.' This keeps a true zero-motion/zero-capture pole in the session instead of a dishonest middle.

verdicts.reason: Doctrine-clean under the binding motion law: the crossfade fires ONLY on a real data-driven fingerprint change, at most once per poll burst (reuses the verified coalescer), never idle/ambient/decorative; user-initiated renders stay instant; Reduce Motion collapses to instant via the same verified check as the existing hover fade (HUDPanel.swift:92). The ghost frame is alpha-blending between two TRUE states — pulse-honesty forbids unbacked green/ready/fresh, which never occurs; no mock softens a state. The scoped key session sits inside the sanctioned keyboard-session envelope: user-consented (their own chord IS the request), honestly shown (caret freezes — unlike still-ledger's lie), mouse paths never set the flag, app never activates, one-flag revert, and it delivers the first real assistive-tech first-responder. Accent focus ring is chrome, not status (color-doctrine: 'Accent is chrome, never status'), spends none of the danger/success/caution budget, and survives gray-swap as a gray outline whose position carries the meaning. Return stays at the Open-on-GitHub ceiling. Its two real costs — whole-pill fade means unchanged pixels shimmer, and 150ms peripheral motion on H2 gauge/freshness ticks strains PRESSURE.md:93's stricter 'actionable change' wording even though INTENT's 'real change' wording sanctions it — are named in its own risks, rendered inspectable (slow-mo + Reduce-Motion toggles, side-by-side instant column), and constitute exactly the choice this gate exists to put before the human. All cited code behavior verified accurate.

The tightest verified fit to every clause: motion maps 1:1 not just to a real change but to the changed CELL (unchanged cells never repaint — the shimmer objection structurally dies); the overwhelmingly common equal-digit tick stays at today's verified zero-pixel stillness; the ONE animated color transition is the critical flip — precisely where color-doctrine spends danger — and prefix fades map to caution's sanctioned degraded-reading event; Reduce Motion zeroes everything; one transition per burst on the existing coalescer. Ink focus (theme.hoverFill + 3px inkPrimary bar — both tokens verified in Theme.swift) adds no hue, passes gray-swap by construction, and the fill-vs-fill+bar grammar keeps hover secondary.
